pages.text: [#](53341a)A Necromantic Stone is the witch's first true token of authority over death-working. Many later rites ask for one, and an **Alluring Skull** answers only to it.[#]()
pages.title: Necromantic Stone

pages.text: [#](53341a)On a small circle at night, offer an Attuned Stone, Bone, Rotten Flesh, Wood Ash, Gunpowder, and Spectral Dust, with **1000 altar power**.[#]()
pages.title: Necromantic Stone

pages.text: [#](53341a)Today the stone is consumed or preserved by later rites such as Prior Incarnation, Manifestation, fetish binding, and Spectral Stone work, and it can wake or silence an Alluring Skull.[#]()
pages.title: Current Use

pages.text: [#](53341a)It also commands bound undead: use it on a target or on the top of a block to send nearby owned thralls there. After drinking an **Infused Brew of the Grave**, sneak-use the stone on an undead creature to bind it.[#]()

[#](53341a)A **Brew of Raising** creates a persistent, lootless undead thrall bearing the curable **Enslaved** effect. It will not attack its owner and, while that effect remains, will answer an attack on the owner from anywhere it is loaded in the same world.[#]()
pages.title: Raised and Bred Thralls

pages.text: [#](53341a)Curing the effect quiets that revenge instinct without erasing the ownership mark.[#]() [#](53341a)A **Brew of Love** used near two adult zombies owned by the drinker turns both parents into zombie villagers without stripping their gear, wounds, or bond.[#]()
[#](53341a)Their baby is an ordinary unowned baby zombie.[#]()
